milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The agent must navigate close to the blue concrete wall (centered at [6, 1, 8] relative to spawn) and face toward it. max_distance=5 ensures the agent must actively walk toward the target (closing from ~8 blocks at spawn to within 5), while facing_tolerance=60 confirms the agent is visually oriented toward the blue concrete. The sandbox verified the agent reaches within 5 blocks by step 10-12, well within the 20-step budget.
